revenue: SUM of total_amount from completed orders
GMV: Gross Merchandise Value = SUM(quantity * unit_price) before discounts
net_revenue: SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount)) from completed orders
active_customers: Customers who placed at least one order in the last 30 days
churn: Customers who were active 60-90 days ago but not in the last 30 days
LTV: Lifetime Value = total_amount spent by a customer across all orders
MoM: Month-over-month: comparing current month vs previous month
YoY: Year-over-year: comparing current period vs same period last year
conversion_rate: Percentage of customers who placed an order
repeat_customers: Customers with more than 1 completed order
new_customers: Customers whose created_at is within the specified period
top_N: Use ORDER BY ... DESC LIMIT N pattern
discount_rate: Average value of the discount column in order_items
product_mix: Distribution of revenue across product categories
